task_type: supplier geography integration and search recovery
requested_outcome: Import every supplier district, area and city independently of listing inventory, expose them in vacation and event search, show genuinely nearby places for zero-inventory destinations, and make those destinations eligible for the existing editorial search-page workflow without auto-indexing thin pages.
natural_destination: VII vacation and event destination picker, zero-result search pages, geography administration and approved search-page sitemap flow
authorization_boundary: Read-only supplier pull, implementation, verification and the standing VII publication workflow are authorized. Automatic publication or indexation of thin destination pages is not authorized and remains behind editorial approval.

lesson_bundle.reason: The short request spans supplier identity, search, fallback ranking, CMS and sitemap policy.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The implementation is tested as one end-to-end geography contract rather than disconnected UI additions.

lesson_bundle.reason: A partial import can look successful while omitting almost every geography.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Counts, Yashresh, Bayt Lid, cross-level ID collisions and exact public behavior require direct evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The repository contains unrelated active work that must be preserved.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Only geography, search recovery, focused tests and their evidence may be changed or staged.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request explicitly connects geography pages to sitemaps.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: A geography can enter the editorial queue, but only approved canonical useful pages may enter a sitemap.

lesson_bundle.reason: Supplier identifiers overlap between hierarchy levels.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Canonical identity always includes geography level and supplier ID, and unassigned records never receive an invented parent.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The import reports success but still contains only Bayt Lid.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Parse named and object-keyed root hierarchy variants, reconcile counts, and verify Yashresh in the accepted payload.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Imported nodes include multiple hierarchy levels, Yashresh, and the unassigned Bayt Lid record.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Yashresh appears in autocomplete but a search shows a generic empty page.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Resolve the selected geography coordinates and rank filtered nearby inventory by bounded geodesic distance.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Vacation and event zero-inventory searches show a clear nearby-results explanation and deterministic nearby cards.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Every imported city is automatically indexed, creating thin SEO pages.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep geography discovery separate from editorial publication state and existing sitemap approval rules.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Unapproved geography pages remain noindex and absent from sitemaps; approved canonical pages remain eligible.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A city ID collides with an area or district ID.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Retain compound keys such as city:2 and district:2 throughout storage and APIs.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Collision fixture stores and resolves both records independently.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the supplier parser and nearby-ranking primitives pass focused fixtures, before UI and release work
checks: Object-keyed hierarchy variants parse without confusing cross-level IDs
Unassigned parent ID zero stays unassigned without a fake area:0 relation
Nearby ranking is coordinate-based, bounded and deterministic
No unapproved geography is added directly to sitemap inventory

attack_questions: Does the production import still expose only one node?
Can Yashresh be selected in both vacation and event search?
Does a zero-inventory search explain that the results are nearby rather than pretending they are local?
Can an unapproved geography URL leak into the sitemap?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact production API counts and live desktop/mobile searches for a zero-inventory city after publication
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused adapter/ranking/SEO tests, build, admin refresh evidence and live public endpoint evidence

effectiveness.baseline: The live geography endpoint contains only one unassigned city and cannot offer the full supplier geography corpus.
effectiveness.target: The complete supplier hierarchy is searchable, zero-inventory destinations recover with nearby inventory, and sitemap inclusion remains editorially gated.
